rule: Before running known-truth informativeness, iteratively remove crosswalk-PASS traits with degree <5 families and families with degree <2 traits, using simultaneous removals per iteration.
exactness: Informativeness can only remove family x trait edges. Therefore a node that already fails the final degree requirement at crosswalk stage can never satisfy it after informativeness. Skipping such systems cannot change the final crossed-core set.
connectedness: Do not use connectedness for pre-pruning; connectedness is evaluated only on the final informativeness-PASS core.
